expected_sections: Article 2 Qualification for Enrolment and Enrolment
Article 3 Representations and Warranties of the Vendor

claim_truth.subject: Tarion Warranty Corporation

object.value: administer the Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act

claim_truth.evidence_quote: Tarion is a private, not-for-profit corporation designated by regulation to administer the Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act.
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: Tarion is a private, not-for-profit corporation designated by regulation to administer the Ontario New Home Warranties Plan Act.

claim_truth.subject: Vendor

object.value: licensed under the New Home Construction Licensing Act, 2017

claim_truth.evidence_quote: be licensed under the New Home Construction Licensing Act, 2017 ; and must ensure that any such homes are qualified to be enrolled
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: be licensed under the New Home Construction Licensing Act, 2017 ; and must ensure that any such homes are qualified to be enrolled

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: fully indemnify and save Tarion harmless from and against any losses, costs, claims, damages and/or liabilities

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall fully indemnify and save Tarion harmless from and against any losses, costs, claims, damages and/or liabilities which may arise resulting from or by virtue of:
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Vendor shall fully indemnify and save Tarion harmless from and against any losses, costs, claims, damages and/or liabilities which may arise resulting from or by virtue of:

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: provide prompt written notice to Tarion if there is a Material Change

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall provide prompt written notice to Tarion if there is a Material Change
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Vendor shall provide prompt written notice to Tarion if there is a Material Change

claim_truth.subject: The Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum templates

object.value: be changed from time to time by governmental directive or by Tarion

claim_truth.evidence_quote: 3.9.3.6 The Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum templates may be changed from time to time by governmental directive or by Tarion
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: 3.9.3.6 The Warranty Information Sheet and Addendum templates may be changed from time to time by governmental directive or by Tarion

claim_truth.subject: The agreement(s)

object.value: provide for the builder to complete the Home and provide statutory warranty coverage

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The agreement(s) shall provide for the builder to complete the Home
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The agreement(s) shall provide for the builder to complete the Home and provide statutory warranty coverage

claim_truth.subject: the lender(s) providing construction financing

object.value: take priority over any such assignment by the Vendor to and in favour of Tarion

claim_truth.evidence_quote: the lender(s) providing construction financing shall take priority over any such assignment by the Vendor
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: the lender(s) providing construction financing for the Homes, and which assignment to the construction lender(s) shall take priority over any such assignment by the Vendor to and in favour of Tarion

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor
claim_truth.evidence_quote: interest at the rate of 1.5 per cent (1.5%) per month, calculated daily (or such other interest rate as may be stipulated from time to time by regulation under the ONHWP Act).
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: interest at the rate of 1.5 per cent (1.5%) per month, calculated daily (or such other interest rate as may be stipulated from time to time by regulation under the ONHWP Act).

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: make the interest payment referenced above on the first day of each month following the date of default in repaying the amounts owed until the amounts owed are repaid in full

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall make the interest payment referenced above on the first day of each month following the date of default
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Vendor shall make the interest payment referenced above on the first day of each month following the date of default in repaying the amounts owed until the amounts owed are repaid in full

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: confirm that the Security (and any and all proceeds derived therefrom) are related to the specific project or the specific Homes

claim_truth.evidence_quote: specifically confirm that the Security (and any proceeds thereof) is held by Tarion
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: specifically confirm that the Security (and any and all proceeds derived therefrom) are related to the specific project or the specific Homes for which the Security was originally provided by the Vendor

claim_truth.subject: The source document

object.value: be in the forms supplied by Tarion without alteration or amendment

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The source document shall be in the forms supplied by Tarion without alteration or amendment
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The source document shall be in the forms supplied by Tarion without alteration or amendment

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: amend or alter the format, logos or language of the standard documents without prior written approval

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall not amend or alter the format, logos or language of the standard documents without prior written approval
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Vendor shall not amend or alter the format, logos or language of the standard documents without prior written approval

claim_truth.subject: The Addendum

object.value: be attached to and forms part of the agreement of purchase and sale

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Addendum shall be attached to and forms part of the agreement of purchase and sale
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Addendum shall be attached to and forms part of the agreement of purchase and sale

claim_truth.subject: the Addendum

object.value: be split up and provisions shall not be distributed in other parts of the agreement of purchase and sale

claim_truth.evidence_quote: For example, the Addendum cannot be split up and provisions shall not be distributed in other parts of the agreement of purchase and sale.
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: For example, the Addendum cannot be split up and provisions shall not be distributed in other parts of the agreement of purchase and sale.

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: modify or amend the Addendum in any way, whether by deleting provisions, adding rider provisions, or otherwise

claim_truth.evidence_quote: the Vendor shall not modify or amend the Addendum in any way, whether by deleting provisions, adding rider provisions, or otherwise
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: the Vendor shall not modify or amend the Addendum in any way, whether by deleting provisions, adding rider provisions, or otherwise

claim_truth.subject: The Vendor

object.value: be responsible for any improper changes to the forms and shall indemnify Tarion against all resulting costs

claim_truth.evidence_quote: The Vendor shall be responsible for any improper changes to the forms and shall indemnify Tarion against all resulting costs
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: The Vendor shall be responsible for any improper changes to the forms and shall indemnify Tarion against all resulting costs

claim_truth.subject: This Agreement

object.value: be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario and the laws of Canada applicable therein

claim_truth.evidence_quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario and the laws of Canada applicable therein
claim_truth.source_evidence_span: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Province of Ontario and the laws of Canada applicable therein
